AFFECT [[1224665461898798997]]
    TRAVERSE [[8397993708429497603]]
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            property ~&197088788&~ _tocSavedScrollPosition: -1

            ~&428051690305612204&~ {
                ~&7083194890448&~: ~&6504254477&~
                function ~&13184053911240945935&~() {
                    _tocSavedScrollPosition = -1;
                }
            }

            function tocShowView() {
                ~&5972376&~ (!~&214637513689&~.~&233748328658231&~) {
                    _tocSavedScrollPosition = (~&254547437090201330&~ && ~&254547437090201330&~.~&502817364213021138&~)
                        ? ~&254547437090201330&~.~&502817364213021138&~.~&7082534202858&~.~&180994&~ : -1;
                }
                ~&214637513689&~.tocShowView(~&6504329801&~);
                ~&214637513689&~.~&233748328658231&~ = ~&6504329801&~;
                /* El modelo del TOC ahora es LAZY (no se construye al abrir el*/
                /* doc). Esta es la ruta "desde toolbar/foldout" (tocFromToolbar*/
                /* = true), que el hook de pages.onVisibleChanged saltea a*/
                /* propósito — así que construimos acá explícitamente. Si el TOC*/
                /* nativo todavía no se parseó, onTableOfContentsUpdated lo*/
                /* (re)construye cuando llega, porque pages.visible ya es true.*/
                ~&15793094956877902211&~.tocBuildModel();
            }

            function tocCloseView() {
                ~&214637513689&~.tocHandleRejected();
            }

            function tocRestoreScrollPosition() {
                ~&5972376&~ (_tocSavedScrollPosition >= 0 && ~&254547437090201330&~ && ~&254547437090201330&~.~&502817364213021138&~) {
                    ~&254547437090201330&~.~&502817364213021138&~.~&7082534202858&~.~&180994&~ = _tocSavedScrollPosition;
                    _tocSavedScrollPosition = -1;
                }
            }

        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
